nodes.description: address public owner; current holder of the 1/1 token, used as source of truth for authorization and balanceOf.
address public approved; single-token approval address used in safeTransferFrom/transferFrom authorization.
uint constant tokenId = 1; the only valid token id checked by tokenURI, ownerOf, getApproved and transfers.
External caller address used for every authorization check (owner/approved) and forwarded as operator to the receiver hook.
constructor(address _owner) sets owner and emits the initial Transfer event.
pure returns 1; constant supply of the 1/1 NFT.
external pure returns the constant uri string when _tokenId == tokenId.
external view; returns 1 only when the query address equals owner.
external view; requires _tokenId == tokenId then returns owner.
public payable transfer with data; authorizes msg.sender, updates approved/owner, then calls onERC721Received on contract recipients.
external payable overload delegating to the 4-argument safeTransferFrom with empty data.
external payable transfer without receiver hook; authorizes msg.sender and moves ownership.
external payable; only owner may set the approved address for tokenId.
external; only owner may set or clear the approved operator address.
external view; returns approved when the queried tokenId is valid.
external view; returns approved == _operator when _owner equals owner.
public view; uses inline assembly extcodesize to detect contract addresses.
external pure ERC165 interface support check.
External callback ERC721TokenReceiver(_to).onERC721Received(msg.sender,_from,_tokenId,data) executed after owner is reassigned; reentrancy vector through attacker-controlled _to.
constructor parameter _owner used to initialize the owner state variable.
tokenURI parameter _tokenId compared against the constant tokenId.
balanceOf parameter _queryAddress compared against owner.
ownerOf parameter _tokenId validated against tokenId.
4-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _from validated against owner.
4-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _to; becomes new owner and controls the receiver call target.
4-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _tokenId validated against tokenId.
4-arg safeTransferFrom parameter data forwarded verbatim to the receiver hook.
3-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _from forwarded to the 4-arg overload.
3-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _to forwarded to the 4-arg overload.
3-arg safeTransferFrom parameter _tokenId forwarded to the 4-arg overload.

transferFrom parameter _tokenId validated against tokenId.
approve parameter _approved written into the approved state variable.
approve parameter _tokenId validated against tokenId.
setApprovalForAll parameter _operator written into approved when true.
setApprovalForAll parameter _approved controls the branch that sets or clears approved.
getApproved parameter _tokenId validated against tokenId.
isApprovedForAll parameter _owner compared with the owner state variable.
isApprovedForAll parameter _operator compared with the approved state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner and approved to authorize safeTransferFrom, so caller identity gates the state-changing transfer.
msg.sender is compared against owner and approved before transferFrom mutates ownership.
msg.sender must equal owner for approve, so caller identity is the only access control.
msg.sender must equal owner for setApprovalForAll, granting operator rights.
msg.sender is forwarded as the operator argument into the external receiver callback.
_to is attacker-supplied and becomes the target address of the external onERC721Received call.
Attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded unvalidated into the receiver hook.
_to is written into the owner state variable, completing the ownership transfer.
_from is read against owner to validate the transfer sender before ownership changes.
_tokenId is compared against the constant tokenId in the transfer precondition.
owner state variable is read during safeTransferFrom authorization and cleared/reassigned.
approved state variable is read to authorize msg.sender and then reset to address(0).
owner state variable is read in transferFrom authorization and subsequently reassigned.
approved state variable authorizes the transferFrom caller and is cleared afterwards.
balanceOf reads owner to decide whether the query address holds the token.
ownerOf returns the owner state variable after validating tokenId.
getApproved returns the approved state variable for the valid tokenId.
isApprovedForAll compares the approved state variable against the queried operator.
approve writes the caller-supplied _approved address into the approved state variable.
setApprovalForAll writes the caller-supplied _operator address into the approved state variable.
_approved boolean selects the branch that sets approved to _operator or address(0).
tokenURI validates _tokenId against the constant tokenId before returning the uri.
ownerOf validates _tokenId against the constant tokenId.
approve validates _tokenId against the constant tokenId.
getApproved validates _tokenId against the constant tokenId.
balanceOf compares _queryAddress against the owner state variable.
isApprovedForAll compares the supplied _owner against the owner state variable.
isApprovedForAll compares the supplied _operator against the approved state variable.
constructor parameter _owner initializes the owner state variable.

Local size variable holds the extcodesize result returned by isContract.

The 3-argument safeTransferFrom delegates execution to the 4-argument overload with empty data.
